name: Italian Fattura
description: Italian invoice (fattura). Detects Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale, IBAN, the SDI recipient code (Codice Destinatario), Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses and emails. Amounts are kept visible so line items stay readable — toggle 'Amounts' manually to hide totals too.

patterns.name: Partita IVA
patterns.description: Italian VAT number: 11 digits, optional 'IT' prefix.

patterns.name: Codice Fiscale
patterns.description: Italian tax code: 16 uppercase letters and digits (case-sensitive).

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: Codice SDI
patterns.description: SDI recipient code for e-invoicing: 6-7 letters and digits, matched with its label (Codice Destinatario, Cod. Dest., Codice SDI, SDI).

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Italian date: DD/MM/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: Italian phone number: landline (0xx) or mobile (3xx), optional +39, not inside longer numbers.
